snippet.title: RUIN: Beast City - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Assassinate your targets with style, as you uncover a plot of world domination and ancient horrors in this boss fight action game. Dive deep into the dark ruins of the Beast City, where only lunatic killers remain. 

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3223030/RUIN_Beast_City/
